'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Mason DS Drop''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Mason]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Mason]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Drop! (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
